WAAREEENER.d: Waaree Energies manufactures solar photovoltaic modules and provides engineering, procurement, and construction services for solar power plants. It is India's largest solar panel manufacturer.

WAAREERTL.d: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited provides solar engineering, procurement, and construction services, along with power generation. It caters to commercial, industrial, and utility-scale customers across India.

WEBELSOLAR.d: Websol Energy System Limited manufactures photovoltaic solar cells and modules. Its customers include solar system integrators and power producers in domestic and international markets.

WENDT.d: Wendt (India) Limited manufactures superabrasives, precision machine tools, and ceramic bond products. Its main customers include the automotive, aerospace, and general engineering industries globally.

WESTLIFE.d: Westlife Foodworld operates McDonald's restaurants across West and South India through its subsidiary. Its main customers are retail consumers seeking quick-service food.

WHEELS.d: Wheels India Limited manufactures steel and aluminum wheels for commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and agricultural tractors. Its main customers are major automotive original equipment manufacturers.

WHIRLPOOL.d: Whirlpool of India Limited manufactures and distributes home appliances including refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners. Its products are sold to retail consumers across India and export markets.

WINDLAS.d: Windlas Biotech manufactures pharmaceutical formulations and provides contract development and manufacturing services. It serves domestic and international pharmaceutical companies and major healthcare brands.

WINDMACHIN.d: Windsor Machines Limited manufactures plastic processing machinery including injection moulding and extrusion machines. Its products are used by plastic product manufacturers and packaging industries.
